summary: A weekly drop-in LEGO building session for grades K-5 at Pack Memorial Library in downtown Asheville, part of Buncombe County Public Libraries' after-school kids programming. The library supplies all the bricks and there is no sign-up, membership, or fixed roster; it's an open library activity, not a club with returning members who know each other.

evidence.note: Listing text is identical week to week ('Come down to Pack Memorial Library and play with LEGOs... make new friends with other LEGO maniacs'), with no mention of membership, dues, sign-up, or named regulars/leaders.

Tags include 'Library Program', 'Drop In', 'After School', 'Materials Provided' and 'K Through 5' - explicitly framed as a library drop-in activity for a school-age grade range, not a persistent club roster.

Buncombe County Public Libraries' own program bulletins list 'LEGO Builders Club' as a recurring program title used across multiple branches (e.g. Enka branch too), confirming it's a standard library program format rather than one specific community group.
The county's own library calendar lists this as 'LEGO Club', a generic recurring children's program, with no group page, Facebook group, or membership sign-up found.
